cues: Blood is a connective tissue whose matrix is a liquid.
Spin it down: about fifty five percent is plasma, mostly water with proteins, sugar, salts and hormones, and forty five percent is formed elements.
Red cells, biconcave discs with no nucleus in mammals, four and a half to five and a half million in each cubic millimetre.
White cells, four to eleven thousand, for defence.
And platelets, one hundred and fifty to four hundred thousand, for clotting.
